title: Pilot Field Kit and Weekly Micro-Sprints
summary: Compact field kit for running a 4-week customer pilot using weekly micro-sprints. Focused on validating an embedded search + multi-model reranker flow with latency budgets and measurable cost targets. This is a working runbook for Solutions Engineering delivery and handoff to Dedicated/Private ops.
objectives: Deliver a functioning prototype of embedded semantic search surfaced in the Atlas web app
Validate multi-model routing (cheap embedding model + strong reranker) under 150ms median inference for search queries
Measure unit cost per query and demonstrate cost within SLO targets (< $0.015/query average)
Create reproducible deployment artifacts and a short ops playbook for scale/rollout
scope: In-scope: index creation, embedding pipeline, search API, model routing policy, basic UI integration
Out-of-scope: full data compliance review, enterprise SSO integration, long-term observability retention >30d
success_criteria: Functional demo: 10 representative queries returning semantically relevant results in UI
Latency: median end-to-end query < 150ms in staging under 80 RPS simulated load
Quality: reranker passes customer QA for 75% of the prompt set (sample of 250 queries)
Cost: measured per-query inference cost <= $0.015 averaged over a 2-day synthetic workload
timeline: Week 0 (Prep): data ingest + index plan, infra sizing, key stakeholder alignment
Week 1 (Kickoff + Build): ingest 50k docs, embedding pipeline prototype, simple search endpoint
Week 2 (Iterate): introduce reranker, implement model routing, latency tinkering
Week 3 (Load + QA): run 80 RPS soak, capture traces and token-level cost, customer QA session
Week 4 (Handoff + Report): finalize deliverables, handoff to customer ops, write rollout notes
day_by_day_tasks: Day -7: Confirm data export format from Atlas (CSV + text id mapping), request sample dataset
Day -5: Create staging VPC project and allocate Dedicated pool nomination (minimal GPU)
Day -3: Seed dataset into dev index, run initial embedding sweep with small model
Day 0 (Kickoff): Workshop with Atlas product + engineering: align queries, metrics, and demo script
Day 1-2: Implement embedding ingestion job, instrument metrics (latency, tokens, errors)
Day 3: Wire up basic search API, smoke test against 100 queries
Day 4-6: Add lightweight reranker model variant, implement routing policy (cost-first then quality fallback)
Day 7: Nightly run: collect token usage, initial cost estimate, update dashboard widgets
Day 8-12: Latency optimization: batching policy tuning, KV cache warmup strategy
Day 13: Customer QA session #1: collect labeled failures and priority bug list
Day 14-18: Fix top-5 failures, add prompt-level evals, add simple automated regression test
Day 19-22: Run 80 RPS soak with synthetic traffic, collect traces and SLA violations
Day 23: Analyze soak, prepare mitigation plan for capacity spikes
Day 24-26: Finalize operations playbook: rollback, model fallback, incident contact list
Day 27: Handoff meeting with Atlas ops and engineering; share runbook and artifacts
Day 28: Postmortem draft and executive one-pager deliverable

prerequisites: Customer provides data dump (min 25k docs) with clear id/text mapping
API access and temporary credentials for Atlas staging environment
Dedicated pool reservation or short-term hosted quota bump
List of 30 canonical queries and a 250-query validation set from the customer
test_plan: Unit tests for ingestion and embedding jobs
Prompt-level evals: 250-query sample with binary good/bad labels
Performance tests: median and p95 latency under 80 RPS synthetic traffic
Cost tests: token accounting and per-query inference billing run for 48 hours
rollout_strategy: Start with canary traffic (5% of queries) on Dedicated pool, monitor 1-hour rolling windows for latency and correctness, gradually increase to 25% then 100% if SLOs hold. Model fallback rules: if p95 latency > 500ms or error rate > 0.5% revert to cached responses and notify on-call.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Customer data contains noisy long documents causing embedding explosion - Mitigation: apply length truncation + paragraph chunking pipeline
Risk: Dedicated pool cold starts add latency spikes - Mitigation: keep warm replicas and use readiness checks before canary
Risk: Cost exceeds target due to reranker token usage - Mitigation: add budgeted truncation and cheaper reranker tier for tail queries
Risk: Divergent quality between staging and prod data - Mitigation: run evaluation on a holdout that mirrors production sample and flag regressions
workshop_agenda: 1:10-1:25 - Instrumentation and metrics review (what we'll measure)
deliverables: Staging environment with index + search API
Operations playbook (runbook) with rollback and fallback rules
Short report: latency, p95/p50, token cost estimates, quality pass rates
Regression test suite and sample labeled eval set
follow_up_actions: Create JIRA board with tasks split by micro-sprint
Schedule weekly 30-min sync with Atlas engineering (fixed cadence)
Send workshop recording and slides within 24 hours
Open PR for runbook into internal repo for SRE review
notes: Notes-to-self: be explicit with the customer about expected noisy rows in the dataset; keep the first two days of the pilot conservative (no autopromotions). Use small-model embedding to get cost baseline then iterate. If we hit cost target early, consider adding relevance probes (randomized A/B reranker) to quantify quality uplift.
